venues.summary: Dear Charles is the restaurant of The Study at Johns Hopkins hotel (Study Hotels), at 3215 N Charles St, Baltimore. It's open, with hours on its location page. Its own group-dining page publishes dearcharles@studyhotels.com, a restaurant booking inbox on the operator's domain (allow_off_domain). The inbox is paired with hotel GM Kathleen Dombrowski, but that is low confidence: she was named GM in a JHU Hub search snippet from Feb 2024 (the page itself returned 403) and is listed as a Study Hotels GM on theorg.com, so check that she's current before saving. No personal email was found anywhere. Study Hotels' email pattern is reportedly FLast@, but it was not used because emails are never guessed.
